component-o.description-s: 3 A 100 V Schottky barrier rectifier, 850 mV VF max, SOD-123FL

forward_source-o.table-s: Maximum Ratings And Electrical Characteristics: Maximum average forward rectified current I(AV) at TL (see fig.1) 3.0 A, all DSK32-DSK320

dynamic_resistance_source-o.table-s: Fig.3 Typical Forward Characteristic, DSK38-DSK310 curve (dark short-dash, third from the left; legend matched on a render, and its 3 A point at ~0.82 V agrees with VF 0.85 V max at 3 A, p1). Vector curve read with procurement pdf-graph; log current axis
dynamic_resistance_source-o.derived: curve vertices 0.52843 V at 0.42126 A and 0.62046 V at 0.99019 A: (0.62046 - 0.52843) V / (0.99019 - 0.42126) A = 0.09203 / 0.56893 = 162 mOhm over ~0.4-1.0 A. Next span 0.65285 A (0.57015 V) -> 1.469 A (0.67877 V) = 0.10862 / 0.81615 = 133 mOhm; it falls with current. Typical curve, TJ not printed (ratings at 25 C)

cj_source-o.table-s: Maximum Ratings And Electrical Characteristics: Typical junction capacitance CJ 250 pF (DSK32-DSK34) / 160 pF (DSK35-DSK320, the DSK310 column group; Fig.4 p2 groups them the same way); Note 1: measured at 1 MHz and 4.0 V reverse

source-o.table-s: Maximum Ratings And Electrical Characteristics, DSK310 column: VRRM 100 V, I(AV) 3.0 A, VF 0.85 V max at 3.0 A, IR 0.3 mA max at 25 C (5.0 mA at 100 C)
source-o.polarity-s: Page 1, Mechanical Data: "Color band denotes cathode end"; the SOD-123FL outline on the same page draws the band at one end. The datasheet does not number the terminals. Pin 1 = cathode is the footprint's numbering (footprints/DSK310.pretty: pad 1 at x = -1.63 mm, silkscreen bar at x = -0.72 mm on the pad-1 side; DSK310.kicad_sym pin 1 = C), so the part's band goes over the silkscreen bar.
source-o.land-pattern-s: Page 3, Suggested Pad Layout: pads 1.2 x 1.2 mm, 3.2 mm centre to centre, 2.0 mm gap, 4.4 mm overall. The footprint's pads are 1.2 x 1.2 mm at 3.26 mm centres.
